All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE:** Ticket `fwrd40-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (ref **RD-1015**), initial status Draft. The create form required only the Title field.

**Objective 2 — DONE:** Part `fwrd40-n1 RD Part A` (cost 100, markup 25%) added. Computed price: **$125.00** ($100.00 + 25% markup, qty 1).

**Objective 4 — DONE:** Part A's cost changed from 100 to 150 (markup unchanged at 25%). Computed price afterwards: **$187.50** ($150.00 + 25% markup). Ticket total: $437.50.

The first "Mark Ready" attempt was rejected with the alert: *"Ticket is not ready Part "fwrd40-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier Part "fwrd40-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"*. The ticket was then archived via the "Archive ticket" button (no confirmation dialog), which changed to "Unarchive ticket". The ticket now carries both "Ready" and "Archived" badges and no longer appears in the default active ticket list — it only shows when the "Show archived" checkbox is checked (row: "RD-1015 fwrd40-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived Not recorded Ready 0 2026-09-03").
